name: Mifune (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Mifune town emblem in white: a winged ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Mifune, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1960.

features.role: Mifune town emblem — a winged ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised device
